modules.title: Financial Statement Analysis Tools Techniques And Standards
modules.summary: This course will cover the different tools and techniques used in financial statement analysis, such as horizontal and vertical analysis, ratio analysis, and budget analysis. It will also cover the types of financial ratios used to analyze the financial health of an organization, including liquidity ratios, profitability ratios, and solvency ratios. Additionally, the course will provide an understanding of the International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS).
